metadata.title: Enable U Data Assets
metadata.description: Governed data assets required to operate a multi-platform managed integration, data and transaction portfolio with tenant isolation and explicit customer ownership.

assets.name: Customer Tenant and Service Agreement

assets.businessMeaning: The boundary that tells every platform action which customer, contract, support tier and responsibility applies.
assets.accessScope: Least-privilege tenant and team access; customer administrators retain control of their organization's data and entitlements.

governance.retention: Retained only for the contractual, operational, fiscal or legal period documented per tenant; lifecycle and deletion are evidence-backed.

governance.sharingPolicy: No cross-tenant sharing. External sharing requires an explicit purpose, contract, recipient and minimum-data policy.
